title: FEI 01 Universal Reduction
assignment: Map the recovered manuscript's implications to full uniform-cube FEI. Isolate the first unsupported dimension-independent estimate with complete quantifiers. Prove a strictly weaker nontrivial endpoint, or prove a source-valid equivalence without representing a restatement as progress. Track unpaid hypotheses eliminated.

title: FEI 02 Joint Coding
assignment: Seek a lossless or probabilistically justified code for the entire Fourier set that charges shared choices once. Establish a decoding theorem and an expected codelength bound against total influence. Retain labels, signs where needed, empty-set treatment, and overhead. Track universal cost terms paid.

title: FEI 03 Overlap Representations
assignment: Strengthen sparse activated-formula or overlap representations while controlling both activation cost and representation cost. Distinguish the known conditional coding implication from the unproved existence of uniformly cheap representations. Track proved representation families and the exact remaining universal bound.

title: FEI 04 Addressing Obstructions
assignment: Stress-test every joint-coding/overlap proposal on addressing, multiplexers, iterated addressing and selectors sharing variables. Derive exact H and I identities or certified bounds; diagnose precisely when coordinatewise accounting introduces a spurious logarithm. Feed minimal counterexamples to B02 and B03.

title: FEI 05 Rare Restrictions
assignment: Seek entropy accounting that retains rare-event logarithms rather than charging them to a pointwise O(I) budget. Use sparse one-point-defect suspensions and rare restrictions as mandatory falsifiers. Prove a nonlocal amortization or a precise no-go theorem; track the unpaid logarithmic term.

title: FEI 06 Nonlocal Induction
assignment: Develop physical-restriction induction with actual child deficits and a nonreusing global entropy budget. Test addressing, near tensors, and rare restrictions before asserting universal payment. Track the exact induction debt before and after each proposed lemma.

title: FEI 07 Signed Booleanity
assignment: Use exact signed Boolean Fourier identities to obtain nonlinear or logarithmically weighted entropy control. Do not replace Boolean realizability by an arbitrary spectral probability distribution. Unweighted full convolution L2 payment is already obstructed; seek a quantitatively stronger mechanism.

title: FEI 08 KL Credit
assignment: Develop conditional KL or I-projection decompositions that retain hierarchy credit and the actual nonempty spectral law. Prove a useful lower bound for K_occ that pays a specified entropy deficit, or falsify a precise candidate. Do not equate positivity of KL with adequate payment.

title: FEI 09 Prime Gates
assignment: Reduce decomposable functions using exact composition identities, then attack actual prime Boolean gates and arbitrary product biases. Keep source-exact normalizations and endpoint limits. Track the domain or hypotheses of a proved gate inequality, not the number of tested biases.

title: FEI 10 Potential Falsification
assignment: Search for rigorous Boolean witnesses refuting proposed bounded potentials or universal gate inequalities. Retrieve exact current candidate bytes and all known falsifiers first; obsolete 0.337/0.34 repairs are not live universal candidates. A finite sweep cannot certify arbitrary dimension or all real biases.

title: FEI 11 Extremal Structure
assignment: Use true ratio-extremality and criticality to seek structural control of FEI near-extremizers. Test near-tensor one-point surgery; qualitative primitivity or terminality alone does not control raw hidden curvature. Track a proved structural restriction that narrows universal candidates.

title: FEI 12 Composition Structure
assignment: Prove exact composition/tensorization laws useful for paying global entropy, including hierarchy and overlap terms. Seek factorization or decomposition that handles a new irreducible class. Distinguish disjoint composition results from overlapping-input claims.

title: FEI 13 Restriction Martingales
assignment: Explore stopping-time, random-restriction and martingale formulations of the universal entropy debt. Retain conditioning and rare-event costs at every step. Seek a finite optional-stopping or amortized estimate with explicit constants, or a counterfamily to a proposed estimate.

title: FEI 14 Analytic Routes
assignment: Develop a technically distinct analytic approach through hypercontractivity, semigroups, entropy dissipation or functional inequalities. Verify cited primary theorems and constants. Identify what extra Boolean structure avoids the usual dimension/logarithmic loss; track the precise strengthened inequality.

title: FEI 15 Exact Countersearch
assignment: Perform bounded exact Boolean countersearch targeted at live conjectural lemmas, with a mathematically motivated search space and clearly stated resource cap. Verify truth tables, Fourier normalization and H/I comparisons; archive executable code and actual output. Small-case evidence is not full FEI.

title: FEI 16 Counterfamilies
assignment: Construct scalable genuine Boolean families targeting universal FEI or live intermediate claims: selectors, tribes, sparse defects, threshold functions, compositions and near tensors as relevant. Prove asymptotic formulas or rigorous bounds. A failed constant only refutes that constant, not FEI.

title: FEI 17 Certificate Bridge
assignment: Turn the finite core of a promising proof into an exact rational, interval or formal certificate, while checking that its scope bridges to the stated infinite claim. Reject numerical margins without rigorous error control and symbolic identities lacking realizability.

title: FEI 18 Proof Audit
assignment: Independently audit candidate proof chains from B01–B09 using original sources and all quantifiers. Check normalization, hidden hypotheses, exceptional endpoints, coding validity and circularity. Produce either a concrete repaired lemma or an explicit first gap; no status-only auditing.

title: FEI 19 Independent Review
assignment: Independently audit candidate proof chains from B10–B17, cross-check literature novelty using primary sources, and verify exact finite witnesses. Review B18 independently when a full candidate emerges. Preserve useful restricted results while rejecting overbroad conclusions.

title: FEI 20 Synthesis
assignment: Reconcile new complete reports from these twenty FEI streams and the existing Brain FEI inbox; choose the nearest unpaid mathematical bottleneck and work substantively on one lemma. Maintain claim/dependency/counterexample handoffs, allocate nonoverlapping next actions, and distinguish configured runs from executed/saved/reviewed results. Do not change fleet schedules or dispatch additional workers.
